summary: Smoother reconnects and clearer private-agent progress.

improvements: Returning to a conversation restores its recorded outcome without resending the turn.
Files activity follows existing organization jobs while the workspace is open.
fixes: Closing chat preserves admitted work within its original authorization lifetime.
Stop requests cancellation on the private agent and reports an unconfirmed outcome.
Returning from cloud sign-in recovers a stalled background tab.
security: Reconnect does not renew authorization or replace exact owner approval.
Long-running jobs retain their existing authenticated queues; Computer Use stays disabled.
